en.title: Anthropic OSS Scanner: opt-in AI security reports for eligible projects
en.summary: Anthropic OSS Scanner offers no-cost model-driven security scans to eligible critical open-source projects. Core maintainers apply by PR, and fast-track reports are not human-reviewed.
en.detail: Anthropic OSS Scanner is an opt-in vulnerability-finding service for established open-source projects with critical infrastructure or user-security impact. Core maintainers request enrollment through the official repository with project configuration and a Dockerfile; Anthropic reviews signup identity and project scope. Accepted projects receive periodic model-generated findings by email at no charge. The fast-track reports themselves are not human-reviewed or validated before delivery, so maintainers must verify reproductions, severity and patches. This differs from Anthropic's separate Claude Security enterprise offering. Compare it with Claude Security and GitHub Copilot Autofix on eligibility, control of scan scope, human triage, report volume and remediation workflow. The directory has not enrolled a project or audited report accuracy. Selection and future scan frequency are conditional, and the service is not open scanning for arbitrary private repositories.

en.title: CADCraft: open-source CAD control for external AI agents
en.summary: CADCraft is a free open-source CAD editor with MCP, JSON control and CLI surfaces for external agents. It does not bundle a generative AI model; compare file fidelity and setup before use.
en.detail: CADCraft is ArtCraft's open-source CAD and drafting application, available as a native app and through a browser build. It exposes drawing operations through an MCP server, JSON control channel and CLI so an external AI agent can inspect, edit and render a drawing. CADCraft itself does not bundle or provide a generative AI model; the AI decision layer comes from the connected client or agent. Compare it with FreeCAD and Onshape on automation surface, setup effort, format round-trip and review of agent-made edits. The official project describes an early, fast-changing release; some CAD entities it does not model can be lost when saving. Use copies of important drawings and inspect exported files. This directory has not run a CAD round-trip, measured browser performance or tested an MCP client. The ArtCraft product page and storytold repository link to one another; cadcraft.org is an independent community guide, not the canonical product site.
